europe_now.title: Bulgarian Vessel Sunk by Drone Attack in Black Sea
europe_now.summary: A drone strike caused a merchant ship to sink in the Black Sea off Bulgaria's coast. In response, the Bulgarian prime minister summoned the Russian ambassador to address the attack and its implications for regional security.

sources.headline: Bulgarian PM summons Russian ambassador after ship sinks in Black Sea drone attack
Bulgaria summons Russian ambassador after ship sinks in Black Sea drone attack

top_stories.title: French Supermarket Cyberattack Disrupts Refrigeration
top_stories.summary: Hackers compromised the refrigeration systems of hundreds of French supermarkets, causing temperatures to rise and igniting fires. The resulting food spoilage led to losses valued in millions of euros and raised alarms about the vulnerability of critical retail infrastructure.

sources.headline: Cyberattack hits hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling millions of euros in food
Hackers heat French supermarket fridges, sparking fires and spoiling food

top_stories.title: Nationwide Student Protests Sweep France
top_stories.summary: Students across France have launched nationwide demonstrations protesting school conditions, with climate activist Greta Thunberg joining the rallies. The protests reflect growing discontent over education policies and environmental concerns, prompting authorities to brace for further unrest.

sources.headline: France braces for fresh nationwide student demonstrations
Live: Greta Thunberg joins French student protests ahead of nationwide rallies

top_stories.title: Starlink Station Sabotage Investigation in Poland
top_stories.summary: German authorities detained Turkish nationals suspected of sabotaging a Starlink ground station in Poland on behalf of Russia. The incident highlights concerns about foreign interference in critical satellite infrastructure and ongoing investigations into the attack.

sources.headline: Germany detains Turks suspected of sabotaging Starlink station in Poland on behalf of Russia
